proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL tala subsection 1 explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi talī palm and West Pahari hattei tali, plural telī, palm. Simple Goj telī, Dogri tɘli and Pothwari teli match this feminine palm form with vowel notation preserved. Geminate *talla subsection 2 and shortened hastatala forms are distinguished; local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: teli.
